cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a modern miniature railway museum's indoor demonstration platform — during an adult costume event she listens for the unseen model train; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a contemporary overnight train's small dining booth at sunrise — she enjoys a quiet pause before breakfast; a cobbled plaza before a Gothic cathedral with a fountain — holds her keepsake at chest height; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — turns a page of a book lying open on the table; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — kneeling on the ground; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — standing; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; an archery range of targets on a green field — draws a recurve archery bow
